name: Paras Healthcare Limited
summary: Paras Healthcare Limited provides tertiary and quaternary healthcare services. The company provides cardiac sciences, neurosciences, oncology sciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics and sports injury, and renal sciences services. It offers services, such as cardio thoracic vascular surgery and cardiology; medical, radiation, surgical, and hemato oncology, as well as nuclear medicine and bone marrow transplant; and neuroscience, neuro intervention, neurology, and spine surgery.
